Comprehensive Catalog of the 56 Evaluation Measures

Source: vignettes/metrics-catalog.Rmd
metrics-catalog.Rmd

Overview of the Evaluation Architecture

scSimEval evaluates single-cell and multiomics simulation methods using an empirical reference benchmarking framework organized into 56 evaluation measures across 8 canonical categories.

Every measure operates directly on empirical biological reference data and synthetic count matrices generated by simulators across scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, and multiomics (scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq) layers, using normalized expressions, clustering structures, biological replicate annotations, and profiling metadata.

Summary Table of the 8 Categories

Category Domain Measures Modality Scope Primary Focus
I Distributional Properties 14 Shared (scRNA + scATAC) 10 univariate (1D) and 4 bivariate (2D) statistical distances across 7 cell-level, 7 feature-level, and 4 bivariate property pairs
II Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics 5 Shared / Modality-Specific Logistic dropout kinetics (scRNA), quadratic accessibility-sparsity curves (scATAC), and NB excess zero weights (Shared)
III Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance 8 Shared (scRNA + scATAC) Latent manifold RKHS divergence & support (MMD, Precision, Recall) + clustering quality & concordance (ASW, CDI, Purity, ARI, NMI)
IV Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics 5 Shared (scRNA + scATAC) Technical confounder mixing and cross-batch biological transfer (Batch Silhouette, PCR R2R^2, CMS, ISI, Cross-Batch F1)
V Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity 12 scRNA-seq DE (6) & scATAC-seq DA (6) Pseudobulk edgeR-QLF differential recovery (Null P-value uniformity, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC)
VI Multiomics Integration & Alignment 5 Multiomics (Joint Latent Space) Batch ASW, Cell-Type ASW, k-NN Graph Connectivity, Integration ARI, and Integration NMI
VII Trajectory & Lineage Topology 5 scRNA-seq HVG-filtered dynverse benchmark (Saelens et al., 2019): HIM & edge-flip topology similarity, geodesic distance correlation, branch assignment F1, and Random Forest wcor_features
VIII Computational Scalability & Efficiency 2 Computation / Shared Core-Seconds (Elapsed Time×Ncores\text{Elapsed Time} \times N_{\text{cores}}; Lannelongue et al., 2021) and Peak RAM per allocated core (Peak RAM/Ncores\text{Peak RAM} / N_{\text{cores}}, MiB/core or GiB/core; Holtgrewe et al., 2015; Boisvert et al., 2012)
Total 56 Full Benchmark Suite Comprehensive single-cell & multiomics evaluation framework

35 & 36 accuracy DE/DA Accuracy (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity Higher is better Overall DEG/DAR binary classification concordance (scRNA DE & scATAC DA)
37 & 38 precision DE/DA Precision (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity Higher is better Positive predictive value of simulated differential calls (scRNA DE & scATAC DA)
39 & 40 recall DE/DA Recall (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity Higher is better Sensitivity recovering ground-truth reference DEGs/DARs (scRNA DE & scATAC DA)
41 & 42 f1_score DE/DA F1-Score (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity Higher is better Harmonic mean of differential precision and recall (scRNA DE & scATAC DA)
43 & 44 auc DE/DA ROC-AUC (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity Higher is better Tie-averaged ROC-AUC ranking true DEGs/DARs by −log⁡10Psim-\log_{10} P_{\text{sim}} (scRNA DE & scATAC DA)
45 batch_asw Batch ASW (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment Higher is better Within-cell-type batch/modality mixing silhouette (1−|sbatch|1 - |s_{\text{batch}}|)
46 cell_type_asw Cell-Type ASW (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment Higher is better Scaled cell-type silhouette conservation 12(ASW+1)\frac{1}{2}(\text{ASW} + 1)
47 graph_connectivity Graph Connectivity (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment Higher is better Mean largest connected component fraction per cell type in 15-NN graph
48 ari Integration ARI (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment Higher is better Truncated ARI between joint-embedding clusters and true cell types
49 nmi Integration NMI (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment Higher is better Entropy-normalized mutual information in joint multiomics embedding
50 him HIM Topology Sim. (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology Higher is better Hamming-Ipsen-Mikhailov local + Laplacian spectral topology similarity between HVG-inferred milestone networks
51 edge_flip Edge Flip Sim. (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology Higher is better Minimum normalized edge-flip edit similarity between reference and simulated MST milestone graphs
52 geodesic_correlation Geodesic Distance Corr. (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology Higher is better Spearman correlation of pairwise cell-to-milestone geodesic distances across shared HVG PCA landmarks
53 F1_branches Branch Assignment F1 (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology Higher is better Harmonic-mean Jaccard F1 overlap across cellular MST branch assignments (dyneval branch concordance)
54 wcor_features Feature Imp. wCor (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology Higher is better Reference-weighted Pearson correlation of ranger RF (10,000 trees, mtry = 1%) milestone geodesic feature importances
55 core_seconds Core-Seconds (core·s) (VIII) Computational Scalability & Efficiency Lower is better Total cumulative CPU work across threads: Elapsed Time (s)×Ncores\text{Elapsed Time (s)} \times N_{\text{cores}} (Lannelongue et al., 2021; Wratten et al., 2021; Grealey et al., 2022)
56 memory_per_core_mib Peak RAM / Core (MiB/core) (VIII) Computational Scalability & Efficiency Lower is better Peak resident memory footprint per allocated core: Peak RAM (MiB)/Ncores\text{Peak RAM (MiB)} / N_{\text{cores}} (Holtgrewe et al., 2015; Boisvert et al., 2012; Chen et al., 2022)

Category I: 18 Evaluated Distributional Properties

scSimEval extracts 7 cell-level properties, 7 feature-level properties, and 4 bivariate property pairs:

  • Cell-level (7): library_size, log_library_size, tmm_factor (scRNA-seq only; omitted for scATAC-seq), zero_fraction_cell, detection_freq_cell, cell_cor, pca_dist.
  • Feature-level (7): mean_expression, variance, scaled_variance, cv, zero_fraction_feature, dispersion, gene_cor.
  • Bivariate pairs (4): lib_vs_cellzero, mean_vs_sd, mean_vs_featzero, mean_vs_dispersion.
